```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

appendix_dir_default <- normalizePath(
  file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input()), ".."),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
appendix_dir <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("DIAG_APPENDIX_DIR", unset = appendix_dir_default),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
project_dir <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("DIAG_PROJECT_DIR", unset = dirname(appendix_dir)),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
fig_dir <- file.path(appendix_dir, "figs", "internal")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pe_mode <- Sys.getenv("DIAG_PE_MODE", unset = "relative")
if (!pe_mode %in% c("log", "relative", "diff")) {
  pe_mode <- "relative"
}
```

## Overview

Internal diagnostic panel for the three **2026 ICCAT shark WG** base scenarios,
using [`sstruth`](https://github.com/laurieKell/sstruth):

1. `ssCurve()` — equilibrium curves and time series
2. Kobe phase plots
3. Production function (yield vs SSB)
4. Yield vs SSB trajectories on the production function
5. Surplus production vs SSB — **`sprod`** (SS3 / r4ss yield4) and **`sp_ssb`** (SSB-based)
6. Process-error (PE) diagnostics — `pe_mode`: `log`, `relative` \((y-x)/x\), or `diff` \((y-x)\)
7. Four-panel PE residuals (time, vs SSB, ACF, histogram)

```{r config}
sstruth_root <- Sys.getenv("SSTRUTH_ROOT", unset = "C:/active/flr/sstruth")
if (dir.exists(sstruth_root) && requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(sstruth_root, quiet = TRUE)
}
library(sstruth)
library(ggplot2)

# Compatibility shim for older diags installs where parallelLapply is unavailable.
if (requireNamespace("diags", quietly = TRUE) &&
    !("parallelLapply" %in% getNamespaceExports("diags"))) {
  assignInNamespace(
    x = ".ssParallel",
    value = function(x, fun, parallel = TRUE, workers = NULL, ..., .nullOk = TRUE) {
      lapply(x, fun, ...)
    },
    ns = "sstruth"
  )
}

study_id <- Sys.getenv("DIAG_STUDY", unset = "sma-2026")
spec_path <- file.path(appendix_dir, "studies", paste0(study_id, ".R"))
if (!file.exists(spec_path)) {
  stop("Study spec not found: ", spec_path, call. = FALSE)
}
source(spec_path, local = TRUE)
spec <- study_spec()

ss_base <- Sys.getenv("DIAG_SS_BASE", unset = spec$paths$assessment_base)
scenario_ids <- spec$scenarios$ids
scenario_labels <- spec$scenarios$register$label[
  match(scenario_ids, spec$scenarios$register$id)
]

runs <- ssRuns(ss_base, ids = scenario_ids)
has_data <- NROW(runs) > 0L && all(dir.exists(runs$path))

if (!has_data) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
  stop(
    "No SS3 runs found under ", ss_base,
    " for scenarios: ", paste(scenario_ids, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

message("SS base: ", ss_base)
message("Scenarios: ", paste(scenario_ids, collapse = ", "))
```

## i) Read objects with `ssCurve()`

```{r load}
load_curve_one <- function(id, path) {
  out <- curveSS(path, cache = TRUE)
  list(
    tseries = cbind(run = id, out$tseries, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    curve = cbind(run = id, out$curve, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    refpts = cbind(run = id, out$refpts, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
}

pieces <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(runs)), function(i) {
  load_curve_one(runs$id[[i]], runs$path[[i]])
})

pe <- list(
  tseries = do.call(rbind, lapply(pieces, `[[`, "tseries")),
  curve = do.call(rbind, lapply(pieces, `[[`, "curve")),
  refpts = do.call(rbind, lapply(pieces, `[[`, "refpts"))
)
rownames(pe$tseries) <- NULL
rownames(pe$curve) <- NULL
rownames(pe$refpts) <- NULL

# Drop zero-yield equilibrium grid points (SS3 padding rows)
pe$curve <- pe$curve[
  is.finite(pe$curve$ssb) & is.finite(pe$curve$yield) & pe$curve$yield > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

kobe <- ssKobe(runs, parallel = FALSE)

run_col <- "run"
stocks <- sort(unique(pe$tseries[[run_col]]))

# Friendly facet labels where available
label_map <- stats::setNames(scenario_labels, scenario_ids)
if (!is.null(run_col) && run_col %in% names(pe$tseries)) {
  pe$tseries$scenario_label <- label_map[pe$tseries[[run_col]]]
  pe$tseries$scenario_label[is.na(pe$tseries$scenario_label)] <-
    pe$tseries[[run_col]][is.na(pe$tseries$scenario_label)]
  pe$curve$scenario_label <- label_map[pe$curve[[run_col]]]
  pe$curve$scenario_label[is.na(pe$curve$scenario_label)] <-
    pe$curve[[run_col]][is.na(pe$curve$scenario_label)]
  kobe$scenario_label <- label_map[kobe[[run_col]]]
  kobe$scenario_label[is.na(kobe$scenario_label)] <-
    kobe[[run_col]][is.na(kobe$scenario_label)]
  facet_col <- "scenario_label"
} else {
  facet_col <- run_col
}

message("Loaded ", length(stocks), " scenario(s)")
```

## ii) Kobe phase plots

```{r kobe, fig.cap = "Kobe phase plot by scenario (equilibrium F/FMSY vs B/BMSY locus in steel blue)."}
p_kobe <- plotSsKobePhase(
  kobe,
  run_col = run_col,
  pe = pe,
  show_equilibrium = TRUE,
  show_msy = TRUE,
  title = "Kobe phase plot — SMA 2026 base scenarios"
)
if (!is.null(facet_col) && facet_col %in% names(kobe)) {
  # kobePhase facets on run_col; labels stay as ids unless kobe supports labels
}
print(p_kobe)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-kobe-phase.png"),
  p_kobe, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200
)
```

## vi) Surplus production vs SSB

Two empirical series are in `pe$tseries`:

- **`sprod`**: $\mathrm{Bio\_all}_{t+1} - \mathrm{Bio\_all}_t + C_t$ (matches `r4ss::SSplotYield()` / `yield4_surplus_production.png` y-axis, plotted vs SSB)
- **`sp_ssb`**: $\mathrm{SSB}_{t+1} - \mathrm{SSB}_t + C_t$

```{r sp-cols}
sp_cols <- intersect(
  c("year", "bio_all", "ssb", "yield", "sprod", "sp_ssb"),
  names(pe$tseries)
)
knitr::kable(head(pe$tseries[sp_cols], 6), digits = 1)
```

### SSB-based SP

```{r sp-ssb, fig.cap = "SSB-based surplus production vs SSB (sp_ssb)."}
p_sp <- plotSsCurveSpSsb(
  pe,
  run_col = facet_col,
  sp_col = "sp_ssb",
  colour_label = "Scenario",
  show_production = TRUE,
  title = "SSB-based surplus production vs SSB — SMA 2026 base scenarios"
)
print(p_sp)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-sp-ssb.png"),
  p_sp, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200
)
```

## vii) Process-error diagnostics

Relative scale default: `r pe_mode` (`log`, `relative` = \((y-x)/x\), or `diff` = \(y-x\)).

```{r pe-diag, fig.cap = "Process-error diagnostics by scenario (SS equilibrium vs PT fit)."}
pe_panels <- lapply(stocks, function(st) {
  one <- list(
    tseries = pe$tseries[pe$tseries[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    curve = pe$curve[pe$curve[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    refpts = pe$refpts[pe$refpts[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  st_label <- label_map[[st]] %||% st
  diag <- plotSsPeDiagnostic(one, shapePt = 0.5, pe_mode = pe_mode)
  if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
    patchwork::wrap_plots(
      diag$ssb + ggplot2::labs(subtitle = st_label),
      diag$pe,
      ncol = 2,
      widths = c(1.2, 1)
    )
  } else {
    diag
  }
})

if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_pe <- patchwork::wrap_plots(pe_panels, ncol = 1)
  print(p_pe)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-pe-diagnostics.png"),
    p_pe, width = 11, height = 12, dpi = 200
  )
} else {
  pe_panels
}
```

### Diagnostic table

```{r pe-table}
tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stocks, function(st) {
  one <- list(
    tseries = pe$tseries[pe$tseries[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    curve = pe$curve[pe$curve[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    refpts = pe$refpts[pe$refpts[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  d <- ssPeDiagnose(one, shapePt = 0.5)
  data.frame(
    scenario = st,
    label = label_map[[st]] %||% st,
    curve_cor = d$curve_cor,
    curve_rel_rmse = d$curve_rel_rmse,
    pe_cor_ssb = d$pe_cor_ssb,
    likely_misspecified = d$likely_misspecified,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(tab, digits = 3)
utils::write.csv(tab, file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-pe-diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r pe-four, fig.cap = "Four-panel process-error diagnostics (all scenarios)."}

if (!is.null(p_four$panel)) {
  print(p_four$panel)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-pe-four-panel.png"),

    width = 10,

}
```

